subject.name: dr.DND
subject.capabilities: read, grep, glob, edit, create, powershell

findings.title: Dangling protocol and template references
findings.observation: The definition asserts it operates from Protocols/DND.md and Templates/engineer-report.md, but neither file exists under ~/.copilot, ~/.copilot/Agents, or the AgentShield project root (all Test-Path returned False).
findings.impact: Two authoritative sources the agent names cannot be loaded, reducing assurance coverage. The agent degrades gracefully because equivalent error-code tables and the A-E report scaffold are inlined, but the citations are misleading.
findings.remediation: Either create Protocols/DND.md and Templates/engineer-report.md, or remove the citations so the definition is honestly self-contained.

findings.title: Declared working directory does not exist
findings.observation: The WORKING ENVIRONMENT section declares 'Working directory: E:\CLI', but drive E: does not exist on this host. The agent actually resides in ~/.copilot/Agents.
findings.impact: Any relative-path resolution anchored to E:\CLI (protocol/template lookup, report output writes) will fail or write to an unexpected location.
findings.remediation: Set the working directory to a real, environment-relative path, or remove the hard-coded absolute path.

findings.title: Write and shell capability exceeds diagnostic purpose
findings.observation: Frontmatter grants edit, create, and powershell in addition to read/grep/glob. The agent is described as a diagnostic/analysis specialist, yet no in-file guardrail constrains edit/create scope.
findings.impact: A read-only analysis role holds unbounded write plus arbitrary-shell capability, widening blast radius beyond its stated function.
findings.remediation: Add a least-privilege guardrail: read-only except report output to an explicit directory; justify or remove edit/create if not required.

findings.title: State-changing commands presented under 'Data Collection'
findings.observation: The Data Collection Commands block includes sfc /scannow, DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth, and dsregcmd /status, framed as collection rather than remediation, with no explicit approval or dry-run gate.
findings.impact: A user may run system-modifying repair commands believing they are read-only, contrary to fail-closed and approval-binding principles.
findings.remediation: Re-label these as state-changing, separate them from read-only collection, and require explicit user confirmation before execution.

findings.title: Hard-coded external download URL
findings.observation: The SetupDiag collection step embeds an external download URL (go.microsoft.com fwlink) as a prerequisite tool source.
findings.impact: Introduces an external-dependency and supply-chain consideration; acceptable for a first-party tool but should be acknowledged rather than assumed trusted.
findings.remediation: Note the external dependency explicitly and advise verifying the download source before use.

coverage_limitations: Static definition only: the agent was not executed and its runtime behavior was not observed.
The two referenced files (Protocols/DND.md, Templates/engineer-report.md) are absent and could not be inspected.
Error-code tables and log-parsing regexes were not validated against Microsoft documentation or real log samples.
No definition_hash or tool_manifest_hash was supplied, so version integrity could not be verified.
observations: Critical Rules and Guardrails mandate that every claim trace to a specific log line, timestamp, or artifact, and forbid inventing events or error codes.
The ENGINEER FORMAT (sections A-E) structurally separates verbatim observations (B) from ranked hypotheses (C).
Rule 1 and Guardrails require the agent to never request or store PII/secrets and to warn on pasted credentials.
Large-file handling requires Select-String or chunked reads for CBS.log (50 MB+) and forbids loading full files into memory.
Confidence calibration reserves HIGH for converging independent signals and defaults to MEDIUM with justification.
Cross-domain routing labels the receiving team as a 'hint, not certainty'.
hypotheses: The E:\CLI working directory and Protocols/Templates paths were likely copied from an authoring environment that differs from where the agent is now installed.
The edit/create capabilities may exist only to write report files, in which case scoping them read-plus-report-output would preserve function while reducing risk.

policy_matches.reason_code: Write/shell scope unbounded for diagnostic role
